card.name: Start of thromboembolism after venous
card.fires_on: The first piece "TH" or "Th" of the word thromboembolism, thrombosis or thromboembolic right after "venous" (or "deep venous"), mostly in capitalised warning headings.

modes.label: Capitalised warning heading
modes.description: All-caps boxed warning lists where VENOUS is followed by the opening piece of THROMBOEMBOLISM.
modes.example: WARNING: INCREASED RISK OF VENOUS<< TH>>ROMBOEMBOLISM AND DE

modes.label: Title-case section heading
modes.description: Warnings or section titles where Venous is followed by the opening piece of thrombosis or thromboembolic.
modes.example: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Venous<< Th>>romboembolic Events (VTE

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with the middle pieces of a long word such as thromboembolism, though the listed tokens look unrelated.
card.plain: It spots the start of the word thromboembolism after the word venous in warning headings.
